reference: Polymetallic massive sulfide, Potter Mine (Commons title)

description.lithology: Light grey to dark grey very fine-grained banded chert / siliceous exhalite with contorted swirled folding in upper pieces and dark green fine-grained foliated to banded chloritic mafic volcanic in lower row
description.alteration: strong silicification in upper light banded interval and moderate to strong chloritic in lower dark green interval
description.mineralization: disseminated to blebby brassy-yellow sulfides, likely chalcopyrite-pyrite, as patches and thin stringers along banding and in a dark vein, ~2-3 vol% overall locally ~5%

anomalies.explanation: Brassy-yellow disseminated grains, patches and thin stringers occur in the upper light banded core and along a dark vein in the lower dark green core, totaling a few percent.
Abrupt lithology change from upper light contorted-banded siliceous rock to lower dark green foliated chloritic rock should be checked as a contact.
